changenote: v6.7.2f Fixed city export failures caused by missing road outlines. Added an in-window warning when the game is still running. Added clearer guidance for rendering failures that may be caused by insufficient memory. Fixed a misleading “startup failed” message when communication between the renderer and its window is interrupted.

changenote_zh: v6.7.2f 修复部分道路轮廓缺失导致城市无法导出的问题。在导出窗口内增加游戏仍在运行的提示。为可能由内存不足引起的渲染失败补充处理建议。修复渲染器与界面通信断开时误报“启动失败”的问题。
